subject: Risk & Compliance
title: The Future of Corporate Governance
description: A quick, practical guide to The Future of Corporate Governance.

hook.text: Governance started as shareholder protection. Now it covers climate, AI, cyber, diversity, and more.

buildup.text: Modern boards must oversee an expanding universe of risks that didn't exist a decade ago.

discovery.text: Technology enables real-time governance dashboards, continuous auditing, and instant shareholder feedback.

twist.text: More oversight doesn't guarantee better outcomes. Information overload can paralyze boards as easily as ignorance can.

climax.text: The best governance balances structure with judgment. Rules matter, but so does the wisdom to apply them.

punchline.text: More risks. More rules. The board's job keeps growing.

quiz.question: What is the biggest challenge for modern corporate governance?
options: Overseeing an expanding universe of new risks
Having too few risks to manage
Reducing the number of board meetings
